page.layout: One page of a table, with a running head and page number at the top. The table has six columns: An.Iuliani, Lit.domin., Nabonasari, Feriæ, a column of dates with dashes (Iun.), and Christi. at the right. Below the table, at the bottom right, is the printed number 316.
page.notes: The printed number 316 at the bottom right of the page is not part of the table and is not transcribed as text. Some Roman-style numerals in the scan are printed in old-style figures (for example 1001, 1005, 1013), copied here as Arabic digits. The table's dash column shows Iun. dates on the rows where a date is printed; the other rows are blank in that column.
